sources.name: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack
Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Eberron: Rising from the Last War

species.name: Aasimar
species.description: Aasimar are mortals who carry a spark of the Upper Planes within their souls.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.description: The ancestors of dragonborn hatched from the eggs of chromatic and metallic dragons.

species.name: Dwarf
species.description: Dwarves were raised from the earth in the elder days by a deity of the forge.

species.name: Elf
species.description: The elves' curiosity led many of them to explore other planes of existence.

species.name: High Elf
species.description: High elves have a keen mind and a mastery of at least the basics of magic.

species.name: Wood Elf
species.description: Wood elves have keen senses and intuition, and their fleet feet carry them quickly and stealthily through their native forests.

species.name: Drow Elf
species.description: Drow are elves that are infused with the magic of the Underdark.

species.name: Gnome
species.description: Gnomes are magic folk created by gods of invention, illusions, and life underground.

species.name: Goliath
species.description: Goliaths are distant descendants of giants that tower over most folk.

species.name: Halfling
species.description: Halflings possess an adventurous spirit that leads them on journeys of discovery.

species.name: Human
species.description: Found throughout the multiverse, humans are as varied as they are numerous.

species.name: Orc
species.description: Orcs have gifts that help them wander great plains, vast caverns, and churning seas.

species.name: Tiefling
species.description: Tieflings are either born in the Lower Planes or have fiendish ancestors.

species.name: Changeling
species.description: With ever-changing appearances, Changelings reside in many societies undetected.

species.name: Kalashtar
species.description: Kalashtar are the union of humanity and renegade spirits from the plane of dreams.

species.name: Khoravar
species.description: Khoravar are descended from humans and elves and have developed their own identity.

species.name: Shifter
species.description: Shifters descend from people who contracted full or partial lycanthropy.

species.name: Shifter
species.description: Shifters descend from people who contracted full or partial lycanthropy.

species.name: Warforged
species.description: Warforged are mechanical beings built as weapons to fight in the Last War.

species.name: Duskling
species.description: Dusklings use the magic of the Feywild to suffuse themselves with magical effects.

species.name: Geppettin
species.description: Geppettin resemble living playthings made of wood, cloth, or porcelain.

species.name: Mandrake
species.description: Mandrakes are green emissaries who make peace between animal and plant realms.

species.name: Dhakaani Guul'dar
species.description: Dhakaani bugbears are known as guul'dar and are celebrated for their strength.

species.name: Gnoll
species.description: Gnolls were once hyenas infused with malefic power by archfiends of war and the wild.

species.name: Dhakaani Golin'dar
species.description: Dhakaani goblins are known as golin'dar and are respected for their smithing.

species.name: Jhorgun'taal
species.description: Jhorgun'taal are celebrated as a symbol of the bond between orcs and humans.

species.name: Dhakaani Ghaal'dar
species.description: Dhakaani hobgoblins are known as ghaal'dar, known for their versatility and vision.

species.name: Kalamer Landwalker
species.description: Kalamer Landwalkers are merfolk who embrace life above the water.

species.name: Ruinbound
species.description: A Ruinbound is born with a personal symbiont, an unnatural entity bound to the child.

species.name: Sahuagin
species.description: The Sahuagin are an ancient species spawned in the ocean depths.

species.name: Variant Aasimar
species.description: Aasimar often attempt to to right wrongs and defend goodness on the Material Plane.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.description: Dragonborn look like dragons in humanoid form, though they lack wings or a tail.

species.name: Drow Elf
species.description: Drow are elves that are infused with the magic of the Underdark.

species.name: Hill Dwarf
species.description: Hill dwarves have keen senses, deep intuition, and remarkable resilience.

species.name: Eladrin Elf
species.description: Creatures of magic with strong ties to nature, eladrin live in the Feywild.

species.name: Forest Gnome
species.description: A gnome's energy and enthusiasm for living shines through every inch of their body.

species.name: Half-Elf
species.description: Half-elves combine what some say are the best qualities of their parents.

species.name: Half-Orc
species.description: Some half-orcs rise to become proud leaders, while others become adventurers.

species.name: Lightfoot Halfling
species.description: Lightfoot halflings can easily hide from notice, even using others as cover.

species.name: Human
species.description: Humans are the innovators, the achievers, and the pioneers of the worlds.

species.name: Tiefling
species.description: Tieflings are gifted with magic from the hells but chart their own course in life.

species.name: Aarakocra
species.description: Sequestered in high mountains and atop tall trees, the aarakocra evoke wonder.

species.name: Air Genasi
species.description: Genasi embody the elemental power of the Inner Planes, expressing it through their bodies, abilities, and connection to the elements.

species.name: Bugbear
species.description: Thanks to fey magic, bugbears are quiet skulkers despite their formidable builds.

species.name: Centaur
species.description: Centaurs gallop through the multiverse and trace their origins to different realms.

species.name: Changeling
species.description: A changeling can shift its face and form with a thought as a form of expression.

species.name: Custom Lineage
species.description: You can select between a number of traits to represent your character's origin.

species.name: Dhampir
species.description: Dhampirs retain their grip on life yet are endlessly tested by vicious hungers.

species.name: Earth Genasi
species.description: Genasi embody the elemental power of the Inner Planes, expressing it through their bodies, abilities, and connection to the elements.

species.name: Fairy
species.description: Infused with the Feywild's magic, fairies look like small elves with insectile wings.

species.name: Firbolg
species.description: Distant cousins of giants, the first firbolgs wandered the forests of the multiverse.

species.name: Fire Genasi
species.description: Genasi embody the elemental power of the Inner Planes, expressing it through their bodies, abilities, and connection to the elements.

species.name: Githyanki
species.description: The lanky Gith complement their physical abilities with psionic power.

species.name: Githzerai
species.description: The lanky Gith complement their physical abilities with psionic power.

species.name: Goblin
species.description: Goblins pursue their own destinies, escaping the plots of both archfey and gods.

species.name: Goliath
species.description: Goliaths are ferocious competitors and are driven to outdo their past efforts.

species.name: Harengon
species.description: Harengons are keen rabbitfolk blessed with a little fey luck.

species.name: Hexblood
species.description: Hexbloods are individuals infused with eldritch magic, fey energy, or witchcraft.

species.name: Hobgoblin
species.description: Hobgoblins trace their origins to the ancient courts of the Feywild.

species.name: Kalashtar
species.description: Kalashtar are created from a union of humanity and spirits from the plane of dreams.

species.name: Kenku
species.description: Feathered folk who resemble ravens, kenku are blessed with observation and memory.

species.name: Kobold
species.description: Kobolds are some of the smallest draconic creatures in the multiverse.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.description: Lizardfolk are gifted with remarkable physical defenses and a connection to nature.

species.name: Minotaur
species.description: Minotaurs are barrel-chested humanoids with heads resembling those of bulls.

species.name: Orc
species.description: Gruumsh's blessings have made orcs tireless guardians and mighty allies.

species.name: Reborn
species.description: Reborn are individuals who have died yet, somehow, still live.

species.name: Satyr
species.description: Originating in the Feywild, satyrs thrive on the energy of merriment.

species.name: Beasthide Shifter
species.description: Beasthide shifters are stoic and solid, drawing strength from the beast within.

species.name: Longtooth Shifter
species.description: Longtooth shifters are fierce and relentless, channeling the instincts of the beast within.

species.name: Longtooth Shifter
species.description: Longtooth shifters are fierce and relentless, channeling the instincts of the beast within.

species.name: Beasthide Shifter
species.description: Beasthide shifters are stoic and solid, drawing strength from the beast within.

species.name: Swiftstride Shifter
species.description: Swiftstride shifters are quick and agile, drawing speed from the beast within.

species.name: Swiftstride Shifter
species.description: Swiftstride shifters are quick and agile, drawing speed from the beast within.

species.name: Wildhunt Shifter
species.description: Wildhunt shifters are keenly aware, drawing on the senses of the beast within.

species.name: Wildhunt Shifter
species.description: Wildhunt shifters are keenly aware, drawing on the senses of the beast within.

species.name: Tabaxi
species.description: Created by the Cat Lord, Tabaxi are a varied people in both attitude and appearance.

species.name: Tortle
species.description: Tortles live on many worlds, most often journeying up and down coasts and waterways.

species.name: Triton
species.description: Triton have extended their stewardship over the sea floor to the ocean's surface.

species.name: Verdan
species.description: The verdan owe their existence to chaos, finding their way in an unfamiliar world.

species.name: Warforged
species.description: Built as weapons, Warforged must now find a purpose beyond war.

species.name: Water Genasi
species.description: Genasi embody the elemental power of the Inner Planes, expressing it through their bodies, abilities, and connection to the elements.

species.name: Yuan-ti
species.description: Each yuan-ti manifests their serpentine heritage in a variety of ways.

species.name: Grung
species.description: Grungs are aggressive froglike humanoids found in rain forests and tropical jungles.
